Class LibraryState

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.presentation.libraryViews.LibraryState
public final class LibraryState extends Object
Immutable per-request view state of the My Library page, built from the query string.

The desktop kept this state in a mutable object inside a singleton controller. On the web the state lives in the URL, so one instance is created for every GET /library request by fromParams(String, String, String, Long, Long, Long) and handed to the template. The recognised parameters are view (songs|albums|artists|favourites), mode (grid|list), sort (a SortStrategy constant name), genre (a genre id) and the drill-ins album and artist (ids). Missing or invalid values fall back to the desktop defaults: Albums view, grid mode, alphabetical sort, no genre filter.

The URL builder methods (tabUrl(String), modeUrl(String), ...) reproduce the way the desktop changed one piece of state and kept or reset the rest: switching tabs resets sort, genre and mode, switching the display mode keeps sort and genre.

SRP: only resolves and describes view state; it never touches a repository or service.

  • Method Details

    • fromParams

      public static LibraryState fromParams(String view, String mode, String sort, Long genre, Long album, Long artist)
      Resolves the view state from raw query parameters, applying the desktop defaults.

      An album drill-in wins over an artist drill-in. The artist drill-in forces the Artists tab and defaults to grid mode (desktop drillIntoArtist); the album drill-in forces list mode (desktop drillIntoAlbum). Top-level Songs and Artists views are always lists, Albums defaults to grid and Favourites defaults to list, as in the desktop switchView.

      Parameters:
      view - requested tab, may be null or invalid
      mode - requested display mode, may be null or invalid
      sort - requested sort strategy name, may be null or invalid
      genre - requested genre id filter, may be null
      album - album id to drill into, may be null
      artist - artist id to drill into, may be null
      Returns:
      the resolved state
